name: ShipMonk
description_en:
ShipMonk provides third-party fulfillment services supported by its order, inventory, warehouse and transportation platform. It is a logistics operating relationship, not simply a standalone inventory-software subscription.

An ecommerce brand evaluates both the software view and physical execution: inbound stock, storage, order routing, pick/pack, delivery and returns. Contract scope and per-service charges are central to understanding the cost.
description_zh:
ShipMonk 提供第三方履约服务，并以订单、库存、仓库和运输平台支持。它是一项物流运营合作，不只是独立库存软件订阅。

电商品牌需同时评估软件可见性与实物执行，包括入库、存储、订单路由、拣配、交付和退货。合同范围与各服务费用是成本判断的核心。

core_features.explanation_en: The platform describes order status, routing rules, stock across locations, lots/expiry and reporting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台描述订单状态、路由规则、跨地点库存、批次与有效期及报表。

core_features.explanation_en: The pricing page scopes storage, pick/pack, receiving, returns, shipping and special projects separately.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格页分别说明存储、拣配、收货、退货、运输及特殊项目。

sections.title_en: Pilot inbound receipt through return disposition
sections.title_zh: 试点从入库收货到退货处置
sections.en: Send representative SKUs with agreed labeling and inbound documentation, reconcile the received quantity and connect a sales channel. Follow an order through routing, pick/pack and tracking, then return an item and inspect its stock disposition. The platform describes barcode validation and inventory controls; their real accuracy and operational SLA were not independently tested.
sections.zh: 按约定标签和入库文件发送代表性 SKU，核对收货数量并连接销售渠道。跟踪订单路由、拣配和追踪信息，再退回一件商品并检查库存处置。平台描述条码验证及库存控制，但实际准确率和作业 SLA 未独立测试。

sections.title_en: Build a full fulfillment cost model
sections.title_zh: 建立完整履约成本模型
sections.en: The current official pricing page is quote-led. Storage, fulfillment, shipping, special projects and returns have separate cost drivers. It explicitly says the custom proposal outlines platform, onboarding and add-on technology fees, so old “free software” assumptions are unsafe. Lot control is typically billed per carton; custom packaging can count as an additional picked item, and fragile wrapping costs depend on dimensions.
sections.zh: 当前官方价格页采用询价。存储、履约、运输、特殊项目及退货具有不同成本驱动。页面明确表示定制报价会列出平台、上线与附加技术费用，不能沿用软件免费假设。批次控制通常按箱收费；定制包装可能按额外拣货商品计，易碎包装依尺寸收费。

sections.title_zh: 计入最低费用与批处理
sections.en: The monthly-minimum FAQ gives a formula: projected monthly orders multiplied by the first-item pick fee, reduced by 20%. The actual pick fee is determined during sales scoping. For subscription/crowdfunding batches, identical-content batches below 50 orders have a setup-related batching fee. Inventory counts, relabeling, repackaging and quality checks may be separately quoted special projects.
sections.zh: 月最低费用 FAQ 给出公式：预计月订单数乘首件拣货费，再减少 20%；实际首件费在销售阶段确定。订阅盒或众筹的相同内容批次不足 50 单时有批处理设置费。盘点、重新贴标、重新包装和质检可能属于另行报价的特殊项目。

sections.title_en: Confirm custody, insurance and service exceptions
sections.title_zh: 确认保管、保险与服务例外
sections.en: Brands outsourcing fulfillment can evaluate the combined technology and warehouse network. A team retaining all physical operations should first confirm whether any standalone software arrangement exists. The FAQ presents adding ShipMonk’s site to the merchant’s insurance or waiving inventory insurance; do not infer automatic stock coverage. Verify damaged stock, lost shipment, peak capacity, exit inventory and claims responsibilities in the agreement.
sections.zh: 外包履约的品牌可评估技术和仓网组合。保留全部自营实物作业的团队应先确认是否存在独立软件安排。FAQ 列出将 ShipMonk 地点加入商家保单或放弃库存保险，不能假设自动承保库存。应在协议中确认破损库存、丢件、旺季容量、退出取货及索赔责任。
